# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" as the application name.
- **System Date and Time**: "Oct 23 01:43" is shown in the center of the title bar.
- **System Notification Icon**: A bell icon is visible next to the date and time.
- **Window Control Buttons**: Located on the far right of the title bar, including minimize, maximize, and close buttons.
- **Operating System Taskbar**: Visible at the top of the screen, showing the "Activities" button on the far left.
- **Application Icons in Taskbar**: A row of application icons is visible on the left side of the screen, including Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, and others.

## Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: "File", "Edit", "Selection", "View", "Go", "Run", "Terminal", "Help" are listed from left to right.
- **Active Menu Indicator**: The "File" menu is highlighted with a blue underline, indicating it is currently selected or active.

## Explorer Panel

- **Panel Title**: "EXPLORER" is displayed at the top of the panel.
- **Folder Structure**:
  - **USER Folder**: Expanded, showing subdirectories and files.
  - **Subdirectories**: `.cache`, `.config`, `.gnupg`, `.ipython`, `.local`, `.mozilla`, `.pki`, `.ssh`, `.thunderbird`, `.var`, `.vscode`, `Desktop`, `Documents`, `Downloads`, `Music`, `Pictures`, `project`, `Public`, `server`, `snap`, `Templates`, `Videos`.
  - **Files**: `.bash_history`, `.bash_logout`, `.bashrc`, `.lesshst`, `.profile`, `.selected_editor`, `.sudo_as_admin_successful`, `.viminfo`, `requirement.txt`.
  - **File Icons**: Files are marked with icons indicating their type (e.g., text files, configuration files).
- **Folder Expansion**: The "USER" folder is expanded, showing its contents.
- **File Icons**: Files are marked with icons indicating their type (e.g., text files, configuration files).

## Welcome Tab

- **Tab Title**: "Welcome" is displayed as the active tab.
- **Tab Controls**: A close button (X) is visible on the right side of the tab.
- **Tab Icon**: A blue icon resembling a document with a checkmark is displayed next to the tab title.

## Main Content Area

- **Welcome Message**: "Visual Studio Code" is displayed prominently at the top, followed by the tagline "Editing evolved".
- **Start Section**:
  - **Options**: "New File...", "Open File...", "Open Folder", "Connect to...".
  - **Icons**: Each option is accompanied by an icon (e.g., a document icon for "New File...").
- **Recent Section**:
  - **Label**: "Recent" is displayed.
  - **Item**: "project" is listed as a recent item.
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - **Title**: "Walkthroughs" is displayed.
  - **Options**:
    - "Get Started with VS Code" with the description "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding".
    - "The Fundamentals" (partially visible).

## Trust Folder Dialog

- **Dialog Title**: "Do you trust the authors of the files in this folder?".
- **Icon**: A blue shield icon with a keyhole is displayed on the left side of the dialog.
- **Description Text**:
  - "Code provides features that may automatically execute files in this folder."
  - "If you don't trust the authors of these files, we recommend to continue in restricted mode as the files may be malicious. See our docs to learn more."
  - Path: "/home/user".
- **Checkbox**:
  - "Trust the authors of all files in the parent folder 'home'".
- **Buttons**:
  - "No, I don't trust the authors" (gray button, with the text "Browse folder in restricted mode").
  - "Yes, I trust the authors" (blue button, with the text "Trust folder and enable all features").
- **Additional Option**:
  - "Show welcome page on startup" (checkbox, currently unchecked).
